name: Mardenholde Keep
summary: In western Lordaeron, the Scarlet Crusade holds Hearthglen from Mardenholde Keep. Highlord Taelan Fordring rules from the fortress once held by his father, Tirion.

sections.title: Seat of the Fordrings
sections.body:
Mardenholde Keep once governed the principality of Hearthglen and the vales around it. Lord Tirion Fordring ruled from its council chambers with trusted advisors, keeping peace across the region. For generations, Lordaeron's people praised the fortress because it never fell during the Second War.

Then Tirion defended the orc Eitrigg and was exiled. Governance passed to his ambitious apprentice, Barthilas, and later to Tirion's son, Taelan. Taelan inherited his father's domain on the eve of Lordaeron's destruction.

sections.title: Cradle of the Crusade
sections.body: The Scourge advanced through Lordaeron, and Mardenholde Keep came beneath the Scarlet Crusade's banner. Paranoia and dark subversion soon took root in the Crusade's ranks. Dathrohan and the most fervent zealots held Hearthglen as a fortified stronghold for the Crusade.

faq.q: Who controls Mardenholde Keep right now?
aliases: who is in charge of hearthglen keep
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade controls Mardenholde Keep, its main military command in the Western Plaguelands. Highlord Taelan Fordring rules from the main hall, surrounded by elite Scarlet protectors.

faq.q: Why is this fortress so important to Tirion Fordring?
faq.answer: Mardenholde Keep was Tirion Fordring's ancestral home and the seat from which he ruled the region as an Alliance paladin. He raised his family there, then lost his titles and was exiled for defending an honorable enemy.

faq.q: How did the Scarlet Crusade take over Mardenholde?
aliases: how did scarlet crusade get hearthglen
faq.answer: After Tirion's exile and Lordaeron's fall during the Third War, his son Taelan renounced the Silver Hand and joined the Scarlet Crusade. The keep and its garrison now serve the Crusade.

faq.q: Can players enter Mardenholde Keep safely?
faq.answer: No. The Scarlet Crusade sees outsiders as possible plague carriers or enemies of its cause. Anyone who approaches the keep will be attacked unless protected by powerful illusion magic.

angles.text: For a paladin, Mardenholde Keep marks a tragic chapter in the order's history. The Silver Hand's former sanctuary became a place where the order split between the fanatical Scarlet Crusade and the vigilant Argent Dawn.
As a human of Lordaeron, you may see Mardenholde Keep as a bitter reminder. Its proud strongholds survived the orcish wars, only to fall to madness and zealotry during the Scourge.
